events.name: Enem
events.notes: Enormous youth search event, high anxiety, high engagement. Verify exact ENEM date annually. Next priority after AR Dia do Estudante.

events.name: Carnaval
events.notes: Moves with Easter -- verify date annually. Peak search window is the two weeks before. First year -> 4-week lead. Evergreen URL, never year-stamp.

events.name: Volta às aulas
events.notes: Searches build late January, school starts late Jan/early Feb.

events.name: Dia dos Namorados
events.notes: BR's Valentine's-equivalent falls on a different date than ES/MX -- do not reuse a shared San Valentín page/date for BR.

events.name: Festa Junina
events.notes: Underused and very visual -- good fit for seasonal shareable cards.
